episodes.overview: Kang launches a full-scale invasion of Earth using an army of robots, and in order to save New York, the Avengers are forced to unleash the Ultrons who serve as guards for the Negative Zone Prison.

episodes.title: The Kang Dynasty
episodes.overview: The Avengers board Kang's command ship in order to put an end to his invasion of Earth.

episodes.title: The Casket of Ancient Winters
episodes.overview: Dark elf Malekith the Accursed locates an Asgardian artifact that plunges the Earth into eternal winter.

episodes.title: Hail Hydra!
episodes.overview: Black Widow turns to the Avengers for help when Hydra and AIM battle over control of the Cosmic Cube.

episodes.title: Ultron-5
episodes.overview: When Ultron-5 goes out of control and kidnaps Wasp, things go crazy when the droid kills Thor with his lasers.

episodes.title: The Ultron Imperative
episodes.overview: Despite Thor going missing and Captain America ending up in the hospital, the Avengers must stop Ultron from eliminating the world's most flawed creatures-humanity.

episodes.title: This Hostage Earth
episodes.overview: The Masters of Evil take over Earth and Loki double crosses Baron Zemo.

episodes.title: The Fall of Asgard
episodes.overview: Separated across the mythological realms, the Avengers face new threats and make allies for the fight against Loki.

episodes.title: A Day Unlike Any Other
episodes.overview: Eight of the nine realms of Asgard have fallen, only the Earth remains. The Avengers are all that stands between Loki and total conquest.

mcu-tv-marvel-anime-iron-man-2010-s01.title: Iron Man
mcu-tv-marvel-anime-iron-man-2010-s01.summary: When Tony Stark branches his company into Japan, he is opposed by the nefarious Zodiac organization. It's up to Stark's Iron Man to defeat the Zodiac, and defend Japan.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: When Tony Stark branches his company into Japan, he is opposed by the nefarious Zodiac organization. It's up to Stark's Iron Man to defeat the Zodiac, and defend Japan.

episodes.title: Japan: Enter Iron Man
episodes.overview: Tony Stark arrives in Japan with the aim of setting up the Arc Station in the first step in his World Peace Initiative. In front of all of Japan, he announces his new Iron Man model, Iron Man Dio, with himself in the pilot's seat. But during the demo, Dio crashes after a mysterious bug in the operating system.

episodes.title: Going Nuclear
episodes.overview: Tony Stark is accused by Defense Minister Kuroda of trying to avoid controversy by sneaking plutonium into Japan aboard an undefended cargo ship. This ship has been attacked and the plutonium stolen, posing a grave threat. Tony dons the Iron Man armor and vows to retrieve the plutonium and clear his name.

episodes.title: Reap the Whirlwind
episodes.overview: Nanami is trying to get to the bottom of the rash of freak hurricanes that have killed two notable scientists. Her search takes her to Professor Sakamoto, and his former student, Dr. Tanaka. Sakamoto and Tanaka were once part of something called the Tesla Project, which was working to control the weather. Is the Tesla project a part of the weird weather attacking Japan, and even if they figure that out, how do they stop it? Can Iron Man defeat the weather?

episodes.title: A Twist of Memory, a Turn of the Mind
episodes.overview: Tony Stark is backing a charity racing event in order to burnish the image of Stark Industries. Meanwhile, Kawashima, a race car driver who's suffered career-threatening injuries, is won over by A.I.M./Zodiac who promise him they will heal his injuries if he takes out Tony Stark.

episodes.title: Outbreak
episodes.overview: Dr. Tanaka informs Tony that a mysterious epidemic has broken out near the Arc Station. The rampant and deadly disease appears unstoppable, and Tony initiates his own investigation into the cause. Meanwhile, the Self Defense Forces reconnaissance satellites are acting up, and Nagato Sakurai visits Iron Man to ask for his help. Stark and Sakurai join forces, when they discover the Zodiac Mech Aquarius may be behind both.

episodes.title: Technical Difficulties
episodes.overview: When the Arc Station has a series of malfunctions, Tony and Dr. Tanaka discover a Zodiac computer virus has infected the Station's operating systems. The virus spreads to the city's ATM banking computers, train navigation computers and traffic controls, causing chaos. Tony decides the only way to combat the virus is to draw it to another computer... his Iron Man onboard computer!

episodes.title: At the Mercy of My Friends
episodes.overview: Tony and Dr.Tanaka are wake up on an isolated island with no idea how they got there and no hope of getting off the island. Missing his life-saving arc reactor and without his Iron Man armor, how will Tony and Chika be able to escape? And, who put them there in the first place?

episodes.title: Daughter of the Zodiac
episodes.overview: Tony Stark meets Aki, a mysterious young girl with strange powers. Tony is shocked when the girl tells him that she belongs to Zodiac and mentions that she needs Tony, as Iron Man to protect her from Zodiac. Is Aki who she says she is? And even if she is, how can Tony trust her?

episodes.title: A Duel of Iron
episodes.overview: The plutonium needed to prime the Arc Station is stolen and Tony must don the Iron Man armor and fight against Dio. The two Iron Men must fight to the death, with the fate of Japan hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Casualties of War
episodes.overview: "Iron Man is dead!" Dr. Chika Tanaka hears these astounding words from Yinsen's own lips. Meanwhile, the seriously wounded Tony Stark survives with the help of Nagato Sakurai and must devise a way to defeat Dio once and for all. But what awaits the arrival of Iron Man is not only Dio, but also four Iron Man Sigma models as well. How will Tony Stark overcome the hopeless situation he finds himself in?

episodes.title: Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: Held responsible for the event at the Arc Station, Tony Stark is arrested by the Japanese government. But while being transported, explosions rock the Diet parliament building, and suspicions are raised that Stark is behind it. Will Tony Stark be able to clear his name, and take out the real threat behind the Diet bombing?

episodes.title: Endgame
episodes.overview: Tony Stark learns the shocking truth behind Zodiac. Iron Man must muster all his remaining strength in order to stop the nefarious ambitions of his greatest adversary, the man behind Zodiac. But, when an familiar face enters the battlefield, will he be able to do what needs to be done?

mcu-tv-marvel-anime-wolverine-2011-s01.title: Wolverine
mcu-tv-marvel-anime-wolverine-2011-s01.summary: Wolverine is a mutant, possessing animal-keen senses, enhanced physical capabilities, three retracting bone claws on each hand and a healing factor that allows him to recover from virtually any wound, disease or toxin at a accelerated rate.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: Wolverine is a mutant, possessing animal-keen senses, enhanced physical capabilities, three retracting bone claws on each hand and a healing factor that allows him to recover from virtually any wound, disease or toxin at a accelerated rate.

episodes.title: Mariko
episodes.overview: After Logan saves a man named Tesshin Asano, who was being attacked by members of Advanced Idea Mechanics, he reveals Mariko's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Yukio
episodes.overview: After Hideki shoots a drug into Logan to slow his healing factor, he awakens in an apartment, where he's tended to by an assassin named Yukio.

episodes.title: Kikyo
episodes.overview: After a fight with Logan, Kikyo escapes -- and Logan retreats. Meanwhile, Mariko overhears Hideki telling her father that Logan is still alive.

episodes.title: Omega Red
episodes.overview: Logan's fight with Omega Red -- who left him in a cave to die -- takes a toll on Logan, despite his healing factor.

episodes.title: Asano
episodes.overview: Logan uses Yukio's ring blade to sever Omega Red's right arm and slices the box on his chest, defeating him.

episodes.title: Min
episodes.overview: Despite Min's warnings, Logan goes to the island called Dragon Palace. Knowing Wolverine is on the island, Kurohagi sends Vadhaka to take him.

episodes.title: Vadhaka
episodes.overview: After Vadhaka attacks Logan and Min, she tells Logan the statue belongs to Kurohagi -- but it can't move unless the seal is removed.

episodes.title: Koh
episodes.overview: When a broadcast of Yukio's location is sent to Koh's base, Logan says he'll save her rather than let her die to get revenge.

episodes.title: Hell Road
episodes.overview: To reach the Dragon Palace -- where Mariko is getting married -- Logan and Yukio must go through the Hell Road, which has traps set along the way.

episodes.title: Shingen
episodes.overview: As Logan and Yukio fight their way through Hell Road, the statue of Vadhaka appears before them. Meanwhile, the wedding ceremony is about to begin.

episodes.title: Kurohagi
episodes.overview: Consumed with hatred and thoughts of revenge, Logan enters the Dragon Palace, followed by Yukio and Koh. Can Logan stop the wedding in time?

episodes.title: Logan
episodes.overview: Logan engages in his final battle with Shingen at the Dragon Palace. Meanwhile, Kurohagi launches a last-ditch effort to make Mariko his own.

mcu-tv-marvel-anime-x-men-2011-s01.title: X-Men
mcu-tv-marvel-anime-x-men-2011-s01.summary: X-Men, still grieving over the death of Phoenix (Jean Grey), are investigating a case of a missing mutant girl in Northern Japan. This leads them to a mysterious virus that turns mutants into monsters. U-Men and the Inner Circle want it.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: X-Men, still grieving over the death of Phoenix (Jean Grey), are investigating a case of a missing mutant girl in Northern Japan. This leads them to a mysterious virus that turns mutants into monsters. U-Men and the Inner Circle want it.

episodes.title: The Return
episodes.overview: When a young girl named Hisako Ichiki goes missing in northern Japan, her parents seek help in Professor Xavier, who calls on the X-Men to unite.

episodes.title: U-Men
episodes.overview: The X-Men carry out an investigation that leads them to the U-Men, a group of mad scientists whose hideout contains a horrifying secret.

episodes.title: Armor
episodes.overview: Hisako's mutant powers are weakened during a fierce battle between the X-Men and Todd, the U-Men's mad scientist.

episodes.title: Transformation
episodes.overview: The X-Men are put at risk of secondary mutation when the Blackbird is attacked by a bat-like creature showing dangerous signs of Damon-Hall Syndrome.

episodes.title: Power
episodes.overview: Emma allows Professor Xavier to read her mind and reveal her thoughts after Cyclops opposes her membership in the X-Men.

episodes.title: Conflict
episodes.overview: An intense battle ensues when the X-Men are attacked by remnants of the U-Men after being forced to execute an emergency landing in the Blackbird.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.overview: Having defeated the U-Men, the X-Men come face to face with Yui Sasaki at her underground base, where she once ran a school for mutant children.

episodes.title: Lost
episodes.overview: After falling ill with Damon-Hall Syndrome, Riko and Kaga attack the X-men's base, while Emma spies on a stranger in her diamond form.

episodes.title: Revelations
episodes.overview: Revelations abound when it's discovered that Riko and Kaga were drugged by Yui and that Jun and Mastermind are one in the same.

episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.overview: Mastermind's evil plans are frustrated as a fierce battle between the X-Men and the Four Pillars of the Inner Circle rages on.

episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.overview: Despite Yui's attempts to suppress them, Takeo's powers continue to gain strength, causing reality itself to become more and more twisted.

episodes.title: Destiny
episodes.overview: The X-Men mount an attack to bring down Professor Xavier's son, Takeo, before he destroys the world, putting an end to both mutants and humanity.

mcu-tv-marvel-anime-blade-2011-s01.title: Blade
mcu-tv-marvel-anime-blade-2011-s01.summary: Legendary half-vampire, half-human vampire hunter Blade is tracking Deacon Frost, a very powerful and influential vampire who killed his mother and who heads Existence, a secretive vampire organization that operates in Southeast Asia.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: Legendary half-vampire, half-human vampire hunter Blade is tracking Deacon Frost, a very powerful and influential vampire who killed his mother and who heads Existence, a secretive vampire organization that operates in Southeast Asia.

episodes.title: His Name Is Blade
episodes.overview: A nightclub is used by vampires to trap unsuspecting guests and feed on them. Just as the feast is about to start, Blade arrives looking for the ancient vampire who long ago infected his mother - Deacon Frost. However, he gets company.

episodes.title: A Night for the Living, A Mourning for the Dead
episodes.overview: Sakomizu, a middle-aged police detective in Osaka, is troubled by a recent series of missing Southeast Asian women. After he meets up with Blade, they discover that the chief of police is helping to provide local vampires with human blood.

episodes.title: Dead on Arrival
episodes.overview: Aboard a cargo ship heading for the Philippines, Blade departs Kobe Harbor hot on Deacon Frost's trail. Makoto, a young human female vampire hunter, is also on the ship. She seeks vengeance and her target is - Blade.

episodes.title: That Was Then, This Is Now
episodes.overview: Determined to rescue his mentor, Van Hesling, from the clutches of a pack of Mandurago vampires, Blade tracks him to a local slum in the Philippines. He also remembers his difficult childhood and the time he met his undead mother.

episodes.title: The Island of Fire
episodes.overview: Siquijor Island, the location of an Existence research facility, is home to the Berdugo tribe who have used white magic to keep vampires under control since ancient times. Against the wishes of the Berdugo, Blade and Makoto set out in search for Frost's facility.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.overview: A small village in Sumatra has been taken over by Frost's people. The men are forced to work in his silver mine, while all the women have been turned into vampires. The local medicine man believes he can cure them, but Blade doubts that.

episodes.title: Claws and Blades
episodes.overview: Blade and Makoto arrive in the lawless island city of Madripoor, where the weapons factory that Frost's men use to melt silver is located, and are instantly attacked by them. That's when Blade's old friend shows up - Wolverine.

episodes.title: Old Wounds, Fresh Blood
episodes.overview: In the jungles of Vietnam, Blade is attacked by a band of vampire ninjas led by Kikyo Mikage, an amoral master samurai with mutant powers similar to Wolverine's. G.I. Stan Davis, a victim of secret US weapons program, helps Blade.

episodes.title: The Bond
episodes.overview: Blade has no choice but to fight the mutant assassin, Kikyo Mikage. While fighting, they remember the time when they were studying sword fighting together under the same master. However, their old master suddenly appears - now a vampire.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.overview: Captured Blade is taken to the Existence research lab known as 'The Factory', in Cambodia, to be experimented on by Deacon Frost who divulges his own tragic personal history, twisted motives and awful ambitions. Makoto finds them.

episodes.title: The Last Sunset
episodes.overview: While in captivity and pushed to his limits, Blade struggles to regain control of himself as his allies attempt a daring rescue. Ironically, this gets Frost closer to his goal and Blade loses a friend. The vampire council is next.

episodes.title: The Final Glory of Deacon Frost
episodes.overview: Blade invades Amaurot, the City of Vampires and headquarters of Existence, while cutting his way through anything that stands between him and now evolved Deacon Frost. Frost's monstrosities fight back, but Blade gets surprise help.

mcu-tv-ultimate-spider-man-2012-s01.title: Marvel's Ultimate Spider-Man
mcu-tv-ultimate-spider-man-2012-s01.summary: While being trained by S.H.I.E.L.D., Spider-Man battles evil with a new team of teen colleagues.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: While being trained by S.H.I.E.L.D., Spider-Man battles evil with a new team of teen colleagues.

episodes.title: Great Power
episodes.overview: One year after becoming Spider-Man, a teenage Peter Parker is approached by Nick Fury to train with S.H.I.E.L.D. Spidey turns Fury down, but soon finds that villainous forces may require him to join the big leagues after all.

episodes.title: Great Responsibility
episodes.overview: Spider-Man accepts Nick Fury’s offer to become the Ultimate Spider-Man and meets his new allies of young heroes consisting of Nova, White Tiger, Power Man and Iron Fist. Meanwhile, Norman Osborn orders Doctor Octopus to send the Frightful Four to target Spider-Man. Spider-Man ends up having to get help from his new allies to fight off the Frightful Four.

episodes.title: Doomed
episodes.overview: After a childish argument between Spider-Man and Nova gets their entire team grounded, the super-youths go through S.H.I.E.L.D.'s database of the most wanted supervillains to see who they can defeat and apprehend in order to impress Nick Fury. When the choices Batroc the Leaper, Blizzard, Melter, MODOK, Toad, Whirlwind, and Lady Porcupine prove unpopular, Spider-Man and his team go to Latveria to track down Doctor Doom. The young heroes fairly easily capture Doom, but things take a turn for the worst when Doctor Doom tricks the team into taking one of his Doombots aboard the Helicarrier.

episodes.title: Venom
episodes.overview:
Under the supervision of Osborn, Doctor Octavius obtains a sample of Spider-Man's blood in order to create a creature that rivals the powers of the wall crawler.

 

Meanwhile, Peter attempts to balance his friendship with Harry with his time with his SHIELD teammates.

episodes.title: Flight of the Iron Spider
episodes.overview: When Spider-Man meets his idol Iron Man, he receives a specialized gift: the Iron Spider suit. However, Spider-Man experiences difficulty learning how to use the suit and begins to neglect his teammates. Meanwhile, the heroes battle the Living Laser, who takes advantage of Spider-Man's lack of experience using the new suit.

episodes.title: Why I Hate Gym
episodes.overview: Taskmaster goes undercover and infiltrates Peter's school to seek out Spider-Man. Spider-Man and White Tiger must put their differences aside and find a way to defeat an opponent who can mimic all of their physical abilities.

episodes.title: Exclusive
episodes.overview: Spider-Man agrees to a video interview with budding news reporter Mary Jane Watson, who gets a more exclusive scoop than she could ever have anticipated when Spider-Man and The Incredible Hulk engage in an all-out battle against Zzzax throughout Manhattan.

episodes.title: Back in Black
episodes.overview: It is bad enough Spider-Man catches a cold, but things drop from bad to worse when a new Spider-Man dressed in black attempts to replace him. Are his friends right and is his jealousy is getting the best of him, or is the new Spider-Man Venom's latest victim?

episodes.title: Field Trip
episodes.overview: While on a field trip, Spider-Man and his superhero friends encounter the mighty Thor, who is transformed into a frog by his mischievous half-brother Loki. Now, the heroes must venture to the magical world of Asgard in order to save the nine realms from Loki's wrath.

episodes.title: Freaky
episodes.overview: Spider-Man and Wolverine must overcome clashing personalities and styles in order to defeat Mesmero and Sabretooth.

episodes.title: Venomous
episodes.overview: Venom resurfaces, using Harry as his host, yet again, and this time Harry's neglecting father becomes his main target. While Norman Osborn does not want his potential secret weapon damaged, Spider-Man is confronted with the dilemma of either trying to help Harry on his own or putting his trust in his teammates, who have orders from Fury to finish Venom off.

episodes.title: Me Time
episodes.overview: After a fight with Whirlwind, Spider-Man insists on a weekend off from Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D.. Unfortunately, Doctor Octopus chooses this very time to attack Spider-Man when his job is threatened by Norman Osborn.

episodes.title: Strange
episodes.overview: When New York is plunged into a mystical sleep, Iron Fist and Spider-Man (who is at first highly sceptical of magic) seek the help of Doctor Strange. In order to break the spell, the three heroes must face their own worst fears in the face of the spell's initiator, the extradimensional entity known as Nightmare.

episodes.title: Awesome
episodes.overview: Peter Parker scrambles to focus his attention between completing his science fair project with Luke Cage and combatting Juggernaut. In his desperation concerning the first case, he decides to "borrow" one of Dr. Connor's inventions ... which (literally) becomes an even bigger threat to the city.

episodes.title: For Your Eye Only
episodes.overview: After being late for training, Spider-Man is faced against an evil super army called Zodiac and their leader, Scorpio, who took over the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier and set it on self-destruct. Spider-Man and Fury must put their differences aside and fight the new menace as a team.

episodes.title: Beetle Mania
episodes.overview: Spider-Man and his team are put on S.H.I.E.L.D. security detail to protect the all-too-critical-for-his-own-health J. Jonah Jameson from the Beetle, a prospect Spider-Man does not enjoy. Things do get personal when Spider-Man must also protect a highly determined Mary Jane, who is on her way to the Bugle for a job interview, from the high-tech villain.

episodes.title: Snow Day
episodes.overview: When Phil Coulson wants the heroes to report to the S.H.I.E.L.D. ice base for winter survival training, Spider-Man and his team sneak off for a vacation on a deserted tropical island that Nova finds under "classy." However, they soon realize something is not right with the island and the Sandman will make sure they never leave.

episodes.title: Damage
episodes.overview: When Spider-Man and his fellow teenage super heroes cause too much damage in a super villain fight, Nick Fury assigns them to work with the super clean-up company Damage Control. While working with Damage Control, Spider-Man uncovers a villainous mystery.

episodes.title: Home Sick Hulk
episodes.overview: Hulk smashes back into Spider-Man’s life where he is sick with an alien infection caused by the Phalanx. Spider-Man has no choice but to take Hulk home and keep him hidden from Aunt May while protecting him from the Phalanx.

episodes.title: Run Pig Run
episodes.overview: Loki exacts revenge on Spider-Man by turning him into a pig, just in time for the Asgardian Boar Hunt across New York City. Now, Thor, who knows all too well how it feels to be transformed into a helpless animal, must help Spider-Ham survive.

episodes.title: I Am Spider-Man
episodes.overview: Flash Thompson stars as Spider-Man in a Midtown High musical production, and gets a taste of what Spider-Man's life is really like when the Trapster mistakes the football jock for the real web-slinger.

episodes.title: The Iron Octopus
episodes.overview: When Doctor Octopus takes over Iron Man's armors, Spider-Man and team work to stop his attacks on Oscorp and S.H.I.E.L.D.

episodes.title: Not a Toy
episodes.overview: Spider-Man loses Captain America's shield and must retrieve it from Doctor Doom.

episodes.title: The Attack of the Beetle
episodes.overview: Aunt May goes on a date with Phil Coulson, Peter's principal and S.H.I.E.L.D. supervisor, and the Beetle returns to continue his evil deeds.

episodes.title: Revealed
episodes.overview: The Green Goblin is created.

episodes.title: The Rise of the Goblin
episodes.overview: Spider-Man tries to protect Harry Osborn from the Green Goblin and Venom.

mcu-tv-avengers-assemble-2013-s01.title: Marvel's Avengers
mcu-tv-avengers-assemble-2013-s01.summary: The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team. With an all-star roster consisting of Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Hawkeye, Falcon and, occasionally--when she feels like it and only when she feels like it--Black Widow, the Avengers are a team in the truest sense. The Avengers save the world from the biggest threats imaginable--threats no single super hero could withstand.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: The further adventures of the Marvel Universe's mightiest general membership superhero team. With an all-star roster consisting of Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Hawkeye, Falcon and, occasionally--when she feels like it and only when she feels like it--Black Widow, the Avengers are a team in the truest sense. The Avengers save the world from the biggest threats imaginable--threats no single super hero could withstand.

episodes.title: The Avengers Protocol (1)
episodes.overview: When Captain America is apparently destroyed by Red Skull, Iron Man reunites the team to avenge him.

episodes.title: The Avengers Protocol (2)
episodes.overview: Red Skull steals Tony Stark's armor and The Avengers put aside their differences and stop him and M.O.D.O.K. from destroying New York City.

episodes.title: Ghost of a Chance
episodes.overview: The rookie Falcon stands alone to save his team and stop a full scale invasion of Earth after the Avengers fall victim to the body-swapping Space Phantoms.

episodes.title: The Serpent of Doom
episodes.overview: Thor believes he must sacrifice himself to save the world from Doctor Doom, who summons the Midgard Serpent using a powerful Asgardian weapon.

episodes.title: Blood Feud
episodes.overview: To save Black Widow, Captain America leads the team into battle against a former World War II ally who he struggles to convince the team is a real person.

episodes.title: Super Adaptoid
episodes.overview: The Avengers are out-gunned by the high-tech, power-mimicking Super-Adaptoid, and Captain America is the last man standing against the ultimate artificial intelligence!

episodes.title: Hyperion
episodes.overview: Hyperion arrives to save the Earth but his methods become too extreme and the Avengers must stand up to him.

episodes.title: Molecule Kid
episodes.overview: Hawkeye and Black Widow take on a covert S.H.I.E.L.D. mission to bring in the son of a super-villain, but when he is revealed to have a world-bending weapon, they realize keeping their mission a secret may be a fatal mistake.

episodes.title: Depth Charge
episodes.overview: When Attuma tries to sink Manhattan, Hulk is forced to prove his strength or perish trying.

episodes.title: The Doomstroyer
episodes.overview: Doctor Doom takes command of the Asgardian Destroyer armor and Thor has to convince the team to trust the one person who may be able to stop him, Loki!

episodes.title: Hulked Out Heroes
episodes.overview: The Avengers learn what it's like to walk a mile in Hulk's shoes when a Gamma attack by Red Skull turns them into raging monsters - the unlikely duo of Hulk and Black Widow are the last line of defense between the city and the Hulk-Vengers.

episodes.title: Avengers: Impossible!
episodes.overview: The Avengers' world is turned upside down when the shape-shifting mischief-maker Impossible Man makes Falcon the star of his own action movie, but the blockbuster puts all of Earth on the line.

episodes.title: In Deep
episodes.overview: Iron Man and Captain America disguise themselves as villains to infiltrate Red Skull's Cabal, but when their disagreements over strategy cause their cover to get blown, they're forced to take on the entire Cabal alone.

episodes.title: Hulk's Day Out
episodes.overview: When Hulk crash-lands on Earth with amnesia, The Avengers reconstruct a day-in-the-life of Hulk to find out what world-ending threat could have knocked out The Strongest There Is.

episodes.title: Planet Doom
episodes.overview: Thor returns to find Earth under the rule of Doctor Doom, who has changed the past drastically to ensure that the Avengers never formed.

episodes.title: Bring on the Bad Guys
episodes.overview: The Avengers start to see how tough the Cabal is and how much strength they'll need to take it down.

episodes.title: Savages
episodes.overview: Tony becomes too reliant on his tech so Cap challenges him to go without it for one full day.

episodes.title: Mojo World
episodes.overview: Hulk and Hawkeye suddenly find themselves stuck in a death match at the hands of the intergalactic broadcasting master, Mojo.

episodes.title: The Ambassador
episodes.overview: The Avengers put their lives at risk to protect none other than Doctor Doom.

episodes.title: All-Father's Day
episodes.overview: Odin comes to the Avengers Tower demanding his son cease his "fun" on Earth and return to Asgard. Thor promises that if he can't prove the good he does on Earth he'll return home forever.

episodes.title: By the Numbers
episodes.overview: The Avengers and the Cabal have a huge confrontation that leaves the team forever changed. Tony also learns that "the stats" can't be trusted every time -- there's no substitute for human intuition.

episodes.title: Guardians & Space Knights
episodes.overview: When Galactus attacks Earth, Iron Man is able to lead him to another planet but discovers that it is populated and under the protection of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

episodes.title: One Little Thing
episodes.overview: While Iron Man and Ant-Man are trying to stabilize particles that can shrink or grow matter, Falcon gives them terrible news -- his mom is coming to visit, and she has no idea he's an Avenger.

episodes.title: Crime and Circuses
episodes.overview: When the Circus of Crime rolls into town, Hawkeye's dark past begins to surface and puts the Avengers in danger.

episodes.title: Exodus
episodes.overview: Iron Man's confidence is shaken after he inadvertently puts Falcon in harm's way. When the Cabal pulls the trigger on its final plan, Tony has to put aside his personal dilemma and be the leader he was born to be.

episodes.title: The Final Showdown
episodes.overview: With the Tesseract now in the hands of the Cosmic Skull, the world is in catastrophic peril. Iron Man realizes teaming up with the rest of the Cabal might be their only chance for victory.

mcu-tv-hulk-and-the-agents-of-s-m-a-s-h-.title: Marvel's Hulk and the Agents of S.M.A.S.H.
mcu-tv-hulk-and-the-agents-of-s-m-a-s-h-.summary: Joined by the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., a humorously dysfunctional group of teammates who double as family, Hulk tackles threats that are too enormous for any other heroes to handle.

season.title: Season 1
season.overview: Joined by the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., a humorously dysfunctional group of teammates who double as family, Hulk tackles threats that are too enormous for any other heroes to handle.

episodes.title: Doorway to Destruction (1)
episodes.overview: Hulk’s best pal Rick Jones begins making a web-series to show the world Hulk is a hero and Big Green gets his first chance to prove it when Annihilus invades Earth!

episodes.title: Doorway to Destruction (2)
episodes.overview: The newly formed Agents of S.M.A.S.H. -- including a Hulked-out Rick Jones aka A-Bomb -- invade the Negative Zone to stop Annihilus once and for all.

episodes.title: Hulk Busted
episodes.overview: When the Leader hijacks Iron Man's Hulkbuster suits to destroy the Agents of S.M.A.S.H., the team and Iron Man must learn to trust each other and work together to defeat the Leader.

episodes.title: The Collector
episodes.overview: Perceived by the public as "menaces," Hulk and Spider-Man are the only ones left to save the planet from destruction when The Collector captures every last hero on earth.

episodes.title: All About the Ego
episodes.overview: The Hulks face their biggest foe yet when they travel into space to battle Ego the Living Planet, who threatens to tear Earth apart! To survive, they have to tackle the second biggest ego in the galaxy -- Red Hulk's.

episodes.title: Savage Land
episodes.overview: A-Bomb is eager to prove himself to an over-protective Hulk and finds an unlikely mentor in Red, but when Sauron and his army of dinosaurs begin to flood Earth with lava, A-Bomb finds himself facing a true trial by fire.

episodes.title: Incredible Shrinking Hulks
episodes.overview: A-Bomb's birthday calls for a celebratory game of mini-golf, but thanks to the Leader, it's the Hulks who are miniaturized. Now the one-inch heroes must stop the towering Leader from shrinking every city on Earth.

episodes.title: Of Moles and Men
episodes.overview: The Hulk's presence in Vista Verde may be doing the city more harm than good. In order to prevent any danger to its citizens, the Hulk goes underground and becomes the savior to the Moloids but the Hulk soon learns that he might be the one who needs saving!

episodes.title: Wendigo Apocalypse
episodes.overview: As the curse of the Wendigo begins spreading across the team. A-Bomb narrates this heroic episode turned horror flick joined by Marvel's biggest clawed Hero, Wolverine. Together, they must all stop the curse from spreading and do everything in their power to prevent from becoming Wendigos themselves.

episodes.title: The Skaar Whisperer
episodes.overview: Skaar gets a lesson in civility from Doc Sampson while the Hulks battle Absorbing Man, who takes on Gamma energy to turn himself into an unstoppable force.

episodes.title: Into the Negative Zone
episodes.overview: Hulk begrudgingly teams up with The Thing to take the fight to the Leader's doorstep when his arch-nemesis puts the lives of the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. on the line.

episodes.title: Red Rover
episodes.overview: An irritated Red Hulk accidentally drops Devil Dinosaur in Dr. Doom's backyard, prompting the mad dictator to launch a full assault on the Hulks.

episodes.title: The Venom Inside
episodes.overview: Venom is on the prowl and has his sights set on big targets. Hulk must save the day...without smashing as his friends are possessed by Venom. How will the Hulks take on this menacing parasitic villain who's only goal is to destroy Spider-Man?

episodes.title: Galactus Goes Green
episodes.overview: Hulk thinks Galactus is coming to Earth to consume it. But he's really in search of a new Herald and finds great potential in the under-appreciated She-Hulk!

episodes.title: The Trouble with Machines
episodes.overview: The Hulks have crashed their Jump Jet more times than they can count, and it's out for revenge now that the Leader has given it artificial intelligence.

episodes.title: Abomination
episodes.overview: Abomination, a villain from Red Hulk's past, plans to take out the Agents of S.M.A.S.H. one-by-one so he can exact the ultimate revenge and frame the team for destroying Vista Verde.

episodes.title: Mission Impossible Man
episodes.overview: The Hulks meet their biggest fan -- Impossible Man! But he also proves to be their biggest problem when he summons the giant dragon, Fing Fang Foom, to battle them.

episodes.title: For Asgard
episodes.overview: Skaar accidentally triggers Ragnarok and incites the ire of Asgard. Detained by the all-seeing, all-knowing guardian of the Bifrost, Heimdall, the Hulks must save Skaar and battle Thor. Soon the heroes find they must put aside their differences to fight against Malekith and save the realm.

episodes.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
episodes.overview: To help the aspiring magician, A-Bomb get a lesson in hard work, Hulk puts him under the tutelage of the Sorcerer Supreme Dr. Strange -- but when the dreaded Dormammu abducts his teacher, A-Bomb has to use what he learned to save Earth!

episodes.title: Deathlok
episodes.overview: When the Hulks thwart a villain from attacking a girl in the mall, they unintentionally start an alien invasion Deathlok was sent to stop.

episodes.title: Inhuman Nature
episodes.overview: A-Bomb's crush on a mysterious girl leads the Hulks to the secret home of the Inhumans, an isolationist race that threatens to wipe out mankind.

episodes.title: The Hunted
episodes.overview: Annoyed with his fellow Hulks, Hulk takes off for some alone time and stumbles onto an island of monsters where he inherits a family that's far peskier than his own.

episodes.title: Monsters No More
episodes.overview: The world finally accepts the Hulks as heroes, but before they can enjoy their success, a surprise attack from The Leader and his agents of CRASH threaten to destroy Vista Verde and the Hulk's reputation.

episodes.title: Planet Leader
episodes.overview: Battling The Leader becomes more than the Hulks bargained for when they get transported to Skaar's home planet, Sakaar, where they must stop The Leader from controlling the entire planet and the Hulks themselves.

episodes.title: It's a Wonderful Smash
episodes.overview: The Agents of S.M.A.S.H. and the Guardians of the Galaxy must break free of a simulated paradise created by the Collector.

Rora as he takes it off of Spartax with the Drax the Destroyer and Groot providing a diversion for the Spartax Royal Guards. Afterwards, the Guardians of the Galaxy have to deal with Lucy and Supergiant who are jilted that Star-Lord is the Prince of Sparta.

episodes.title: Asgard War (1): Lightnin' Strikes

episodes.title: Inhuman Touch
episodes.overview: The Guardians pay the Inhumans a visit to learn more about the Cosmic Seed.

episodes.title: Welcome Back
episodes.overview: The Guardians discover that the Cosmic Seed is back on Earth. In the company of Cosmo, Star-Lord returns to his hometown where he runs into his childhood bully Michael Coogan who is now the sheriff. Now Star-Lord and the Guardians of the Galaxy must find the Cosmic Seed before Korath the Pursuer does.

episodes.title: I've Been Searching So Long
episodes.overview: When the Guardians of the Galaxy's search for the Cosmic Seed continues on Earth, Star-Lord contacts Gorgon where he gets the location of the former site of Attilan. While checking out the area, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, and Drax the Destroyer have visions of the Cosmic Seed energy helping them out like Rocket Raccoon's family being re-evolved, Groot being able to restore the Flora colossi, and Drax the Destroyer being able to see his family again. Even after fighting their way past the Cosmic Seed-enhanced worms and spiders, the Guardians of the Galaxy must keep Ronan the Accuser and Nebula from getting the box containing the Cosmic Seed.

episodes.title: I Feel the Earth Move
episodes.overview: Now that Thanos has the Cosmic Seed, he takes control of the Earth and molds it into his personal planetary weapon of mass destruction. The Guardians of the Galaxy must work to reclaim the Cosmic Seed from Thanos even when Ronan the Accuser and Nebula plan to dispose of Thanos with plans of having the Earth be destroyed alongside him.

episodes.title: Won't Get Fooled Again
episodes.overview: The Guardians discover that Yondu has been impersonating them in order to con unsuspecting victims.

episodes.title: Jingle Bell Rock
episodes.overview: The team stages a Christmas Carol inspired con-job in order to frighten a despot out of his ill-gotten riches and free his enslaved people.

mcu-tv-marvel-s-spider-man-2017-s01.title: Marvel's Spider-Man
mcu-tv-marvel-s-spider-man-2017-s01.summary: An insecure but courageous and intelligent teen named Peter Parker, a new student of Midtown High, is bitten by a radioactive spider and given powers. season.title: Season 1

episodes.title: Horizon High (1)

episodes.title: Horizon High (2)
episodes.overview: Spider-Man must work to stop the Scorpion from wreaking havoc at the museum.

episodes.title: Osborn Academy
episodes.overview: Norman Osborn creates the Osborn Academy for Geniuses as a way of saving his son, Harry, the embarrassment of being suspended from Horizon High.

episodes.overview: Spider-Man must stop Black Cat from committing a spree of thefts while still keeping his school obligations.

episodes.overview: Horizon High throws a dance in honor of Harry being exonerated, but Norman asks Harry to stay at the Oz Academy.

episodes.title: Sandman
episodes.overview: Spider-Man meets the powerful, yet uncontrollable Sandman and helps him reunite with his estranged daughter with the help of the Venom symbiote.

episodes.overview: When Spider-Man uses his new black costume, he discovers that there is great danger in his new power; and he must find a way to defeat a costume that wants to destroy him.

episodes.title: Stark Expo
episodes.overview: After the terror of the symbiote, Spidey is off to the Stark Expo in his old costume. When Ghost hijacks the event, Spidey's only chance to save lives is to unleash the symbiote.

episodes.title: Ultimate Spider-Man
episodes.overview: When Miles Morales is bitten by an experimental spider and gains spider powers, Spider-Man must teach him the responsibilities of being a superhero.

episodes.title: Kraven's Amazing Hunt

episodes.title: Halloween Moon
episodes.overview: On Halloween night, Spider-Man must team up with the incredible Hulk to stop Man-Wolf, a super-strong gamma-powered werewolf, from infecting the rest of Manhattan.

episodes.title: Spider-Man on Ice
episodes.overview: Spidey must stop a low-level villain who has acquired some impressive freezing technology.

episodes.title: Venom
episodes.overview: The symbiote has escaped the Avengers Compound and attached itself to a new host. Now Spidey must find out how to beat it and who the new person is underneath.

episodes.title: Screwball Live
episodes.overview: Spider-Man is targeted by a new costumed figure named Screwball for a series of online prank videos which block him from fighting crime.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (1)

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (2)
episodes.overview: Spidey invites The Octopus to patrol the streets alongside Miles and himself until it becomes clear that Otto isn't exactly a team player.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (3)
episodes.overview: Peter spends a day at Osborn Academy in the hopes of finding a clue that will convince Harry that his father is out to destroy Spider-Man.

episodes.title: The Rise of Doc Ock (4)
episodes.overview: Spider-Man must team up with Gwen Stacy and a reluctant Harry Osborn to investigate the truth behind the missing Raymond Warren aka the Jackal.

episodes.title: Spider-Island (1)
episodes.overview: Spider-Man tracks a new villain with spider powers who steals his experimental stealth suit and threatens the entire city.

episodes.title: Spider-Island (2)
episodes.overview: Everyone in Manhattan manifests spider powers; Spider-Man and Spider-Gwen must help Black Widow track down Crossbones before he delivers the vibranium to Arnim Zola and Hydra.

episodes.title: Spider-Island (3)
episodes.overview: Peter must find a way to cure Gwen Stacy and Norman Osborn after they turn into spider monsters; things get harder when Kraven the Hunter turns New York into his hunting grounds.

episodes.title: Spider-Island (4)
episodes.overview: Peter and Harry must battle through an island of spider monsters to get to Norman Osborn, who appears to control them all; the boys discover the real mastermind.

episodes.title: Spider-Island (5)
episodes.overview: To cure the spider-monster population of Manhattan, Spider-Man must lead Kid Arachnid, Anya and Harry on a desperate, last-ditch effort to stop the Jackal.

episodes.title: The Hobgoblin (1)
episodes.overview: Spider-Man takes on Doc Ock and his Sinister Five before they brainwash Spidey and destroy New York City.

episodes.overview: Spider-Man must find a way to stop Hobgoblin, who seems completely bent on doing whatever it takes to destroy Spider-Man.

mcu-tv-m-o-d-o-k-2021-s01.title: Marvel's M.O.D.O.K.
mcu-tv-m-o-d-o-k-2021-s01.summary: The megalomaniacal supervillain M.O.D.O.K. has long pursued his dream of one day conquering the world. But after years of setbacks and failures fighting the Earth’s mightiest heroes, M.O.D.O.K. has run his evil organization A.I.M. into the ground. Ousted as A.I.M.’s leader, while also dealing with his crumbling marriage and family life, the Mental Organism Designed Only for Killing is set to confront his greatest challenge yet: a midlife crisis!

season.title: Season 1

episodes.title: If This Be… M.O.D.O.K.!
episodes.overview: Supervillain M.O.D.O.K. runs his evil organization AIM into the ground and is forced to sell it to the tech company GRUMBL. As the megalomaniacal M.O.D.O.K. struggles to regain control of AIM he risks losing something even more important… his family!

episodes.title: The M.O.D.O.K. That Time Forgot!
episodes.overview: In an effort to win back his wife Jodie, M.O.D.O.K. takes her traveling through time to a Third Eye Blind concert they missed years ago. However, things take a wrong turn when they get attacked by a college-aged M.O.D.O.K. who damages their time machine stranding them in the past.

episodes.title: Beware What from Portal Comes!
episodes.overview: M.O.D.O.K. drags along his kids, Melissa and Lou, to a GRUMBL leadership conference. Once there, he accidentally unleashes a hedonistic alien menace on the conference while trying to prove his leadership skills to his bosses and children.

episodes.title: If Saturday Be... For The Boys!
episodes.overview: M.O.D.O.K. is turned away by his world conquering peers and forced to slum it with some blue-collar street villains. He intends to use them for his own gains, but a wild night out on the town leads M.O.D.O.K. to something more valuable: adult friendship?

episodes.title: If Bureaucracy Be... Thy Death!
episodes.overview: M.O.D.O.K. and Monica reluctantly team up to overthrow GRUMBL's control of AIM. Their “complicated” history threatens their mutual goals as they work through their grievances the only way they know how… a mad-scientist fight!

episodes.title: Tales from the Great Bar-Mitzvah War!
episodes.overview: M.O.D.O.K. struggles to “normalize” his weird son Lou’s bar mitzvah planning. Lou flees to Asgard where he and M.O.D.O.K. find themselves on opposing sides of a mythological war that threatens to split the realm in two.

episodes.title: This Man... This Makeover!
episodes.overview: Jodie's celebrity is on the rise and she begins to date the superhero Wonder Man. At Jodie’s book release party, M.O.D.O.K. tries to win her back by provoking Wonder Man into attacking him. The debacle leads to unexpected repercussions.

episodes.title: O, Were Blood Thicker Than Robot Juice!
episodes.overview: The time travelling Young M.O.D.O.K. finally exacts his revenge by kidnapping the family and pitting them against each other in a twisted family therapy / battle to the death.

episodes.title: What Menace Doth the Mailman Deliver!
episodes.overview: M.O.D.O.K. suddenly returns to AIM as a model employee, throwing off everyone at the organization. Austin attempts to reveal to M.O.D.O.K. the terrifying truth about GRUMBL, while Gary and Monica conspire to find out what M.O.D.O.K. is planning.

episodes.title: Days of Future M.O.D.O.K.s!
episodes.overview: The family reunites for Lou’s bar mitzvah but the surprise return of a villain threatens M.O.D.O.K.’s past, present and future in the show’s season finale.

episodes.title: "OMG Issue #2"

Unfortunately for Darryl, the Grandmaster was the only one who answered Darryl's "Roommate Needed" ad and with no viable options, the Grandmaster moves in.
